import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_GRID_SIZE = 11;
    static final int MAX_NODES = 1000;
    static final int MAX_EDGES = 100100;
    static final int INFINITY_VAL = (1 << 29);

    static class Edge {
        int destination;
        int flow;
        int capacity;
        int next_edge;

        Edge(int destination, int flow, int capacity, int next_edge) {
            this.destination = destination;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.next_edge = next_edge;
        }
    }

    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[2 * MAX_EDGES];
    static int[] adjacency_head = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] current_level_ptr = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] level = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] bfs_queue = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int num_edges, total_nodes, src_node, sink_node, queue_tail, queue_head;

    static void reset_flow_network(int n_nodes, int source, int sink) {
        total_nodes = n_nodes;
        src_node = source;
        sink_node = sink;
        num_edges = 2;
        Arrays.fill(adjacency_head, 0, n_nodes + 1, 0);
    }

    static void connect_nodes(int u, int v, int cap) {
        edges[num_edges] = new Edge(v, 0, cap, adjacency_head[u]);
        adjacency_head[u] = num_edges++;
        edges[num_edges] = new Edge(u, 0, 0, adjacency_head[v]);
        adjacency_head[v] = num_edges++;
    }

    static boolean build_level_graph() {
        Arrays.fill(level, 0, total_nodes + 1, 0);
        queue_tail = queue_head = 0;
        bfs_queue[queue_tail++] = src_node;
        level[src_node] = 1;
        while (queue_head < queue_tail && level[sink_node] == 0) {
            int node = bfs_queue[queue_head++];
            for (int idx = adjacency_head[node]; idx != 0; idx = edges[idx].next_edge) {
                int next_node = edges[idx].destination;
                if (level[next_node] == 0 && edges[idx].flow < edges[idx].capacity) {
                    level[next_node] = level[node] + 1;
                    bfs_queue[queue_tail++] = next_node;
                }
            }
        }
        return level[sink_node] != 0;
    }

    static int push_flow(int node, int bottleneck) {
        if (node == sink_node) return bottleneck;
        for (int idx = current_level_ptr[node]; idx != 0; idx = current_level_ptr[node] = edges[idx].next_edge) {
            int next_node = edges[idx].destination;
            if (level[node] < level[next_node] && edges[idx].flow < edges[idx].capacity &&
                (bottleneck = push_flow(next_node, Math.min(bottleneck, edges[idx].capacity - edges[idx].flow))) != 0) {
                edges[idx].flow += bottleneck;
                edges[idx ^ 1].flow -= bottleneck;
                return bottleneck;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic_algorithm() {
        int total = 0, delta;
        while (build_level_graph()) {
            System.arraycopy(adjacency_head, 0, current_level_ptr, 0, total_nodes + 1);
            while ((delta = push_flow(src_node, INFINITY_VAL)) != 0) {
                total += delta;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static int dimension;
    static String[] board1 = new String[MAX_GRID_SIZE];
    static String[] board2 = new String[MAX_GRID_SIZE];

    static int[] move_row = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int[] move_col = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static boolean within_bounds(int r, int c) {
        return (r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < dimension && c < dimension && 
                board1[r].charAt(c) != 'Y' && board1[r].charAt(c) != 'Z');
    }

    static int[][][] time_to_reach = new int[2][MAX_GRID_SIZE][MAX_GRID_SIZE];

    static void bfs_propagate(int sr, int sc, int flag) {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_GRID_SIZE; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX_GRID_SIZE; j++) {
                time_to_reach[flag][i][j] = 0;
            }
        }

        time_to_reach[flag][sr][sc] = 1;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{sr, sc});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0];
            int c = cell[1];

            if (flag == 1 && (time_to_reach[0][r][c] != 0 && time_to_reach[0][r][c] <= time_to_reach[1][r][c])) {
                continue;
            }

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nr = r + move_row[k];
                int nc = c + move_col[k];

                if (within_bounds(nr, nc) && time_to_reach[flag][nr][nc] == 0) {
                    time_to_reach[flag][nr][nc] = time_to_reach[flag][r][c] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[][][] vertex_id = new int[2][MAX_GRID_SIZE][MAX_GRID_SIZE];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        dimension = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();

        int z_row = 0, z_col = 0;

        int total_vertices = 0, source = 0, sink = 0;

        for (int r = 0; r < dimension; r++) {
            board1[r] = sc.next();
            for (int c = 0; c < dimension; c++) {
                if (board1[r].charAt(c) == 'Z') {
                    z_row = r;
                    z_col = c;
                } else if (board1[r].charAt(c) != 'Y') {
                    total_vertices++;
                    vertex_id[0][r][c] = total_vertices;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int r = 0; r < dimension; r++) {
            board2[r] = sc.next();
            for (int c = 0; c < dimension; c++) {
                if (board2[r].charAt(c) != 'Y' && board2[r].charAt(c) != 'Z') {
                    total_vertices++;
                    vertex_id[1][r][c] = total_vertices;
                }
            }
        }

        total_vertices++;
        source = 0;
        sink = total_vertices;

        reset_flow_network(total_vertices, source, sink);

        for (int r = 0; r < dimension; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < dimension; c++) {
                if (board1[r].charAt(c) != 'Z' && board1[r].charAt(c) != 'Y') {
                    connect_nodes(source, vertex_id[0][r][c], board1[r].charAt(c) - '0');
                    connect_nodes(vertex_id[1][r][c], sink, board2[r].charAt(c) - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        bfs_propagate(z_row, z_col, 0);

        for (int r = 0; r < dimension; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < dimension; c++) {
                if (board1[r].charAt(c) > '0' && board1[r].charAt(c) <= '9') {
                    bfs_propagate(r, c, 1);
                    for (int rr = 0; rr < dimension; rr++) {
                        for (int cc = 0; cc < dimension; cc++) {
                            if (board2[rr].charAt(cc) > '0' && board2[rr].charAt(cc) <= '9') {
                                if (time_to_reach[1][rr][cc] != 0 && 
                                    (time_to_reach[0][rr][cc] == 0 || time_to_reach[0][rr][cc] >= time_to_reach[1][rr][cc]) &&
                                    time_to_reach[1][rr][cc] - 1 <= T) {
                                    connect_nodes(vertex_id[0][r][c], vertex_id[1][rr][cc], INFINITY_VAL);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic_algorithm());
    }
}
